verses.pali: “Idhāhaṁ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṁ sūcilomaṁ purisaṁ vehāsaṁ gacchantaṁ.
verses.english: “Just now, reverend, as I was descending from Vulture’s Peak Mountain I saw a man whose body hairs were needles flying through the air.

verses.pali: Tassa tā sūciyo uppatitvā uppatitvā tasseva kāye nipatanti.
verses.english: And those needles kept rising up and falling on his body

verses.pali: eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṁyeva rājagahe sūto ahosi …pe….
verses.english: “That being used to be an equerry right here in Rājagaha. …”
